Limits of the alpha contract-step check (review R2-05): alpha (correspondence/CORRESPONDENCE.md section 2) maps create_temporal_edge to no content and excludes temporal-marked rows, as replay.py does, and its 'tombstone of live content' check (correspondence/tools/abstraction.py:466-472) folds a record's keys against alpha's rows, so a live temporal-only edge is never 'live' and F-C1308's failure passes the check by construction (temporal hole); the redaction step check covers soundness, counts, digests and the marker but not completeness at Final (every live record of the target tombstoned; theorem_final_effect in proofs/), so F-1305 / F-C1302-class outcomes pass (completeness hole); every checked trace is sequential apart from the F-1201 pair. A pass means no violation of the checked contract was seen on the traced inputs, not that the handler performs its step. [review-response R2-05]
